jobs.title: VP of Finance
jobs.description:
Snaplii is hiring a VP of Finance in Toronto who can manage the books, the money, the transactions and the systems together, and who still digs in personally when something breaks.

**About Snaplii**


Snaplii is a profitable North American wallet and payments platform for people and their AI agents, with offices in Toronto and Silicon Valley.

* 400K\+ users and about US$150M in annual payment volume
* 500\+ brand partners, including Costco, Walmart and Uber
* Now building financial infrastructure for people and their AI agents: Snaplii is already live on Muse, with about 2,000 AI agents running on it

**What you'll do**


You report to the CEO and lead the finance organization, including our Financial Controller. In priority order:

* **Finance and controls.** Own month\-end close, financial reporting, external audit and internal controls across our Canada and US entities.
* **Payments finance operations.** You don't reconcile every transaction yourself, but you own the whole mechanism and the outcome of every exception:
	+ End\-to\-end reconciliation across internal transaction records, the user balance ledger, payment processor records and bank statements
	+ Settlement and payouts: correct amounts, timing, receiving entities and approval authority
	+ Exceptions such as missing orders, duplicate payments, delayed settlements, fee differences and refunds not received, traced and closed out
	+ Clear accounting and control boundaries between company operating funds, user funds and settlement funds
	+ Treasury and liquidity: funds kept safe, liquidity sufficient and settlements accurate, with strong bank and payment\-processor relationships
* **Digital transformation.** Find the manual, error\-prone steps in finance and payment operations, then work with product and engineering to automate them and to monitor for fund discrepancies, late settlements and unusual transactions.
* **Team.** Lead, coach and grow the finance team, starting with the Financial Controller.
* **Fundraising and investments.** Partner with the CEO on fundraising, board and investor materials and the numbers behind major decisions; oversee corporate investments.
* **Compliance, over time.** Work with our compliance lead on fund controls, audit evidence and bank requirements, with room to take on more compliance responsibility as you grow into the role.

**How you'll work**


This is a startup seat: you manage the team and do the work yourself.

* While the team is still being built, you dig into the books, chase discrepancies and deal with banks and payment processors yourself
* You make sound calls with incomplete information, and bring risks and proposed fixes to the CEO early
* When you find a cross\-team problem, you push it through to resolution instead of only reporting it
* You keep daily money movement and finance running while you build the systems underneath

**What you bring**

* CPA designation, with a strong accounting and Controller foundation
* Experience leading a full finance function and managing a team
* End\-to\-end ownership of month\-end close, financial statements, external audit and internal controls
* Hands\-on experience with payment or transaction fund flows: reconciliation, settlement, payouts and refunds
* You have led at least one digital transformation of a finance or payment\-operations process and can explain the results before and after. You don't need to write code, but you can read a process, define the rules and verify the outcome
* Real banking and payment\-processor relationship experience you can walk us through with examples
* Professional working proficiency in both English and Mandarin
* Based in the Greater Toronto Area and able to work from our Toronto office


The strongest fit has grown from Controller or finance operations at a payments, wallet, fintech or high\-volume platform company, rebuilt systems hands\-on and led a small team. Big\-company titles count less than having managed the books, the funds and the transaction flows together.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in payments, fintech or other regulated businesses, working with compliance on fund controls, audit evidence and bank requirements
* SQL, BI or API data experience (real implementations matter more than tool names)
* Multi\-entity finance across Canada and the US
* Fundraising, bank credit facilities, data rooms, or investor and board communication
* Business analytics: runway, unit economics and operating KPIs

**Compensation and location**


The role offers an annual compensation package of up to CAD $300,000, including base salary and a performance\-based bonus, depending on experience.


Based in our Toronto office. Our team works in both English and Mandarin.

jobs.title: Director of Enterprise Sales (New Business)
jobs.description:
**Take your career to new heights with Loopio!**
================================================

Loopio is seeking a proven **Director of Enterprise Sales** to lead our team into its next chapter of growth. If you're a proven sales leader who consistently beats quota, builds high\-performing teams, and thrives in fast\-moving, results\-driven environments, we want to talk. Reporting directly to the VP of Sales, you’ll shape the company's strategic direction. You’ll lead an existing team of Account Executives and work closely with leaders across Loopio to achieve our ambitious growth targets in the Enterprise segment (organizations with over 2,500 employees).

 *Note: This is an existing vacancy on the team*

  


**What You’ll Be Doing**
========================

* **Revenue**


	+ Ultimately, you are responsible for acquiring new customers, and achieving our revenue targets
	+ Continually create initiatives to optimize win rates, opportunity generation, deal velocity, and deal size
	+ Partner with the Marketing Team to explore and unlock new revenue opportunities, including new markets and industry segments
* **Team Management:**


	+ Oversee a rapidly growing team of Enterprise sellers
	+ Evolve and scale team structure, management hierarchy, and communication mechanisms
	+ Empower the team to achieve greater focus and efficiency by exploring and implementing strategic role specialization.
* **Talent Acquisition, Development \& Coaching:**


	+ **Build Your A\-Team:** Partner with our Talent Experience team to design and execute a rigorous interview process to attract and hire seasoned enterprise sales talent and high\-potential future stars. Be an active participant in recruiting, from leveraging your network to closing top candidates.
	+ **Accelerate Performance:** Optimize the onboarding and continuous training programs to decrease ramp\-up time and ensure every team member is equipped to excel.
	+ **Lead from the Front:** Roll up your sleeves to actively coach your team through participating in calls, reviewing deal strategy, and providing actionable feedback using tools like Gong and Lattice.
* **Forecasting \& Reporting**


	+ **Forecast with Precision:** Work with the Senior Leadership Team to set ambitious targets, develop accurate sales forecasts, and report on progress to the company and the Board of Directors.
	+ **Embrace Data:** Make data\-driven decisions the standard across the sales organization, using analytics to identify opportunities and mitigate risks.
* **Culture**


	+ Foster and scale a culture of discipline, continuous learning, competitiveness, collaboration, and celebrating success — what’s missing?
	+ **Champion Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Foster a strong, collaborative relationship with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure our GTM strategy is cohesive and our sales team is set up for success.
	+ Actively work to keep a pulse on the engagement, challenges, and well\-being of your team
* **Research \& Awareness**


	+ Work with other Loopio leaders to monitor trends in customers, market, and competitive landscape
	+ Ensure strong alignment between Product Management and Sales to set your team up for success
	+ Keep a pulse on trends, new tools, and best practices in SaaS software sales
* **AI \& Automation:** Drive the adoption of AI tools and automated workflows across the team to accelerate pipeline generation, enhance account intelligence, and optimize deal execution and coaching.

  

**What You’ll Bring to the Team**
=================================

* 10\+ years in B2B software sales, with a focus in new business acquisition
* 3\+ years in B2B Enterprise SaaS software leadership (Director level and above)
* Experience leading a team of Enterprise Account Executives
* Track record of setting and exceeding targets
* Deep analytical abilities and metrics\-driven approach
* Strong understanding of the RFP response process and the challenges that companies face
* Well\-defined leadership style that can be articulated clearly
* Experience with MEDDPICC and Command of the Message would be ideal
* Relevant Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical or business function
* Strong assets:


	+ Experience selling to Sales and Marketing organizations
	+ History of published thought leadership
	+ Experience in scaling a sales team and contributing to organizational growth from $50M to $100M ARR.

  

**Where You’ll Work**
---------------------

* *We are currently only looking for candidates who reside in the Greater Toronto Area and surrounding areas and can access our co\-working space in Downtown Toronto for the occasional Team get\-together.*
* Loopio is a remote\-first workplace because we recognize the advantages of working flexibly. We are HQ’d in Canada, with established hub regions around the world where we hire from.
* Our employees (or Loopers, as we call ourselves!) live and work in Canada (British Columbia and Ontario), US, India (specifically in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Bengaluru), and London.
* The majority of our team is based in ON and BC, which means these employees live and work remotely within a 300km radius of Toronto (within Ontario) and Vancouver (Within BC).
* We offer flexible co\-working locations available to Loopers in ON and BC. Those based in ON have the option of working out of our convenient co\-working space located in the heart of Downtown Toronto and a 12\-minute walk from Union Station. BC Loopers have the option to work centrally in Vancouver. It is whatever works best for you!
* You’ll collaborate with your teams virtually across the UK, India, and North America (we’re just a Zoom call and Slack message away!) with core sync hours and focus time for headsdown work during the workday
* We encourage asynchronous collaboration to effectively work as a global \#OneTeam!

  

**Why You’ll Working at Loopio**
--------------------------------

* Your manager supports your development by providing ongoing feedback

jobs.title: Senior Director, Brand & Cultural Strategy
jobs.description:
Proof Strategies is an independent, Canadian‑owned strategic communications agency that charts its own path. Built on a simple philosophy – that you can do great work with great people and be a great place to work – Proof has grown into an award‑winning agency where curiosity, integrity, and collaboration are deeply valued. Today, we are proud to be one of Canada’s leading communications agencies, partnering with some of the world’s most respected brands and trusted organizations.



Guided by this foundation and a belief in the power of strong human relationships, we are on a mission to help our clients capture attention, earn trust, and move people to action. To support us on this journey, we’re hiring a Senior Director, Brand Strategy, who’s excited to build with us and help shape the agency’s next chapter.


### **The opportunity**



Proof is seeking a Senior Director, Brand Strategy to lead strategic thinking across the agency, elevate the quality and effectiveness of our client work, and help define the next generation of communications planning.



This role combines audience insight, cultural strategy, trend identification, communications planning, and creative inspiration. You will uncover emerging signals, identify shifts in audience behaviour and culture, and translate those insights into powerful communications strategies, earned\-first ideas, brand platforms, campaigns, and stakeholder engagement programs that connect to clear client objectives and create meaningful impact.



You will work closely with client teams, creatives, integrated planners, and research partners to ensure our work is rooted in insight and connected to what matters most to people. You will help teams turn strategic thinking into clear direction, stronger ideas and excellent client initiatives from opportunity and brief through development, execution and evaluation.



Beyond client work, you will help build and grow the agency’s strategic planning capability by evolving our methodologies, integrating AI and new technologies into our process, mentoring talent, and supporting business development efforts and identifying opportunities to strengthen client relationships and agency growth.



Our strategists are active partners to our clients, not behind\-the\-scenes strategists. This role requires someone who can lead and present strategic thinking with confidence, build trusted client relationships, and stay close to the work from insight through execution. You’ll be expected to bring strategic perspective into client conversations, shape the work alongside creative and account teams, and help ensure strategy translates into ideas and outcomes that deliver for our clients.


### **Key responsibilities**


#### **Audience, Cultural \& Market Intelligence**


* Lead primary and secondary research to uncover audience insights, behaviours, motivations, barriers, and opportunities.
* Identify emerging cultural shifts, market signals, risks, and opportunities before competitors.
* Monitor social, economic, technological, media, and consumer trends to inform client strategies and agency thinking.
* Apply AI\-enabled research, intelligence, listening, and forecasting tools to accelerate insight generation and strategic planning.
* Transform complex research findings into compelling narratives and actionable recommendations that inform decisions, shape strategy and identify opportunities for client impact.

#### **Strategic Planning**


* Write insightful and inspiring creative briefs that spark breakthrough ideas.
* Develop strategies that connect business objectives, brand, audience insight, culture, and communications.
* Define clear measures of success and guide teams on performance evaluation and learning.
* Partner with creative, digital, content, and communications teams to develop earned\-first ideas capable of competing with both communications and advertising agencies.
* Lead strategic thinking throughout the development of major client initiatives, ensuring insight, strategy, creative ideas and execution remain connected to the client’s objectives.
* Raise the strategic quality and effectiveness of client work by challenging and strengthening ideas, recommendations and approaches.
* Ensure creative territories and execution remain aligned with audience insight, strategic objectives, and brand positioning.
* Bring cultural relevance and audience understanding into every stage of campaign development.
* Define what success looks like at the outset of an initiative and use insights, data and results to evaluate impact and strengthen future work.
* Translate strategic thinking into clear direction that enables client and agency teams to make strong decisions and move work forward.

#### **Agency Strategy Leadership**


* Define and evolve Proof’s strategic planning offering and point of view.
* Build tools, frameworks, processes, and best practices that strengthen strategic thinking across the agency.
* Champion the adoption of audience\-first and insight\-led planning methodologies.
* Establish Proof as a recognized leader in communications strategy, audience intelligence, and cultural insight.
* Contribute thought leadership, speaking opportunities, articles, and agency marketing initiatives.

#### **Growth \& Business Development**


* Provide strategic leadership in new business opportunities and agency growth.
* Lead strategic discovery, audits, workshops, and planning sessions with prospective clients.
* Contribute to pitch strategy, insight development, positioning, and presentation storytelling.
* Identify and develop new strategic products, services, and opportunities that create value for clients and support agency growth.

#### **Team Development \& Collaboration**


* Mentor teams across the agency, including client leads, and emerging talent.
* Foster a culture of curiosity, learning, experimentation, and innovation.
* Collaborate across practices and disciplines to elevate strategic thinking

Director, Digital \& Information Management is a leadership role responsible for developing and implementing the digital strategy and information management framework for one of our major new build projects. The Director reports functionally to the Vice\-President, Digital Solutions and operationally to the Project Director.


This Director ensures that all project data, documentation, and digital systems are integrated, secure, and aligned with company standards, regulatory requirements, industry standards, and project objectives. The position drives digital transformation to enable efficient collaboration, lifecycle data management, and regulatory compliance across engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning phases.


Key responsibilities include leading project teams, developing work execution plans, recruiting and assigning team members, managing project deliverables, organizational structure, budget, schedule, risk management, and overseeing people forecasting and levelling for the project.

jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer (Not-For-Profit)
jobs.description:
### **STRATEGIC**  **COLLABORATIVE**  **INITIATIVE**  **RESULTS\-DRIVEN**  **ACCURATE**


Our client is a growing, community\-based organization that provides support for youth in the Region of Peel. They are a leading organization recognized for their commitment to providing youth with the resources and services to help them achieve independence and growth. The organization is looking for passionate people to join their vision and mission!

**Are you passionate about accounting and supporting vulnerable youth?**


The Pod Group is partnering with this amazing organization to place a resourceful, hands\-on, and organized individual to fulfill the role of Chief Financial Officer.

**WHY YOUR ROLE MATTERS**

The Chief Financial Officer (CFO) reports to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and serves as a member of the Leadership Team. The CFO will be responsible for the day\-to\-day operations, data entry, grant report entry, managing the organization’s fundraising functions, and helping to create organizational and program budgets in collaboration with the CEO and Directors. This position also contributes to the development and implementation of organizational strategies, policies and practices.

**HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT**

**Financial Management**

* Analyze and present financial reports in an accurate and timely manner; clearly communicate monthly and annual financial statements; collate financial reporting materials for all funder and donor segments, and oversee all financial, project/program and grants accounting.
* Coordinate and lead the annual audit process, liaise with external auditors and the finance committee of the board of directors.
* Oversee and lead the annual budgeting and planning process in conjunction with the CEO; administer and review all financial plans and budgets; monitor progress and changes; and keep the leadership team informed of the organization’s financial status.
* Participate as a member of the bargaining table during the collective bargaining process.
* Manage organizational cash flow and forecasting.
* Implement a contracts management and financial management/ reporting system; ensure that the contract billing is adhered to.
* Update and implement all necessary business policies and accounting practices; improve the finance department’s overall policy and procedure manual.
* In collaboration with the CEO \& Treasurer, communicate and present the financial matters to the board of directors.
* Monitor all fundraising and accounting systems and procedures, capturing pledges, receipts and thank you letters. Recording and allocating all revenue transactions.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly assessments and forecasts of the organization's financial performance against budget, financial and operational goals.
* Conduct monthly reviews of funder allocations.
* Review monthly budget to actual for specific programs and assist managers in managing their budgets.
* Ensure the reconciliation of monthly activity; petty cash, fundraising and accounting systems.
* Prepare and support team with program budgets for funder applications.
* Prepare and report financial deliverables as required.

**Financial Administration**

* Coordinate the materials for the Finance Committee; scheduling, preparing agenda, minutes and reporting package.
* Drive initiatives in the management team and organizationally that contribute to long\-term operational excellence.
* Supervision of staff as required.
* Liaison with CEO to assist in the development of strategic plans for operational activity. Implement and manage operational plans.
* Contribute to short and long\-term organizational planning and strategy as a member of the management team.
* Support the organization's fundraising targets through funding applications, special events, etc.
* Other duties as assigned.

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING**

* Minimum five (5\) years experience working in a not\-for\-profit in a finance leadership role.
* Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance or Accounting or required field.
* Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) designation is required.
* Knowledge of government and funder agency structures, procedures and reporting.
* Experience developing fundraising strategies, grant applications and project proposals that provide core program/organization support is an asset.
* Strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills.
* Highly organized, analytical and detail oriented.
* Excellent time\-management skills with the ability to simultaneously manage multiple projects and meet deadlines in a fast pace, community environment.

**OUR COMMITMENT TO EDIB**


The success of an organization stems from a team that is aligned with its mission and vision, where decisions are made in the best interests of the clients they serve and the marginalized and vulnerable populations across our communities. Through this effort, all team members embrace their roles in the organization with respect and dignity for all stakeholders. Through these partnerships, everyone is focused on ensuring a commitment and responsibility toward anti\-racism, anti\-oppression, equity, diversity, inclusivity, and belonging.

**OUR PARTNERSHIP \- THE POD GROUP**


The Pod Group (PG) connects candidates with amazing career opportunities in Ontario! We collaborate extensively with not\-for\-profit and community\-based organizations, including health, social services, developmental, housing, mental health, and community health care.


We promote a unique candidate experience that integrates equity, diversity, inclusion and belonging in our engagement with candidates. Our recruitment strategy focuses on learning more about your career goals and aligning your passion with mission\-driven work.


We thank you for your interest in applying!


Salary Range: $105,000 to $120,000 CAD Annually


Vacancy: Current Opening

new_jobs.title: VP of Finance
new_jobs.description:
Snaplii is hiring a VP of Finance in Toronto who can manage the books, the money, the transactions and the systems together, and who still digs in personally when something breaks.

**About Snaplii**


Snaplii is a profitable North American wallet and payments platform for people and their AI agents, with offices in Toronto and Silicon Valley.

* 400K\+ users and about US$150M in annual payment volume
* 500\+ brand partners, including Costco, Walmart and Uber
* Now building financial infrastructure for people and their AI agents: Snaplii is already live on Muse, with about 2,000 AI agents running on it

**What you'll do**


You report to the CEO and lead the finance organization, including our Financial Controller. In priority order:

* **Finance and controls.** Own month\-end close, financial reporting, external audit and internal controls across our Canada and US entities.
* **Payments finance operations.** You don't reconcile every transaction yourself, but you own the whole mechanism and the outcome of every exception:
	+ End\-to\-end reconciliation across internal transaction records, the user balance ledger, payment processor records and bank statements
	+ Settlement and payouts: correct amounts, timing, receiving entities and approval authority
	+ Exceptions such as missing orders, duplicate payments, delayed settlements, fee differences and refunds not received, traced and closed out
	+ Clear accounting and control boundaries between company operating funds, user funds and settlement funds
	+ Treasury and liquidity: funds kept safe, liquidity sufficient and settlements accurate, with strong bank and payment\-processor relationships
* **Digital transformation.** Find the manual, error\-prone steps in finance and payment operations, then work with product and engineering to automate them and to monitor for fund discrepancies, late settlements and unusual transactions.
* **Team.** Lead, coach and grow the finance team, starting with the Financial Controller.
* **Fundraising and investments.** Partner with the CEO on fundraising, board and investor materials and the numbers behind major decisions; oversee corporate investments.
* **Compliance, over time.** Work with our compliance lead on fund controls, audit evidence and bank requirements, with room to take on more compliance responsibility as you grow into the role.

**How you'll work**


This is a startup seat: you manage the team and do the work yourself.

* While the team is still being built, you dig into the books, chase discrepancies and deal with banks and payment processors yourself
* You make sound calls with incomplete information, and bring risks and proposed fixes to the CEO early
* When you find a cross\-team problem, you push it through to resolution instead of only reporting it
* You keep daily money movement and finance running while you build the systems underneath

**What you bring**

* CPA designation, with a strong accounting and Controller foundation
* Experience leading a full finance function and managing a team
* End\-to\-end ownership of month\-end close, financial statements, external audit and internal controls
* Hands\-on experience with payment or transaction fund flows: reconciliation, settlement, payouts and refunds
* You have led at least one digital transformation of a finance or payment\-operations process and can explain the results before and after. You don't need to write code, but you can read a process, define the rules and verify the outcome
* Real banking and payment\-processor relationship experience you can walk us through with examples
* Professional working proficiency in both English and Mandarin
* Based in the Greater Toronto Area and able to work from our Toronto office


The strongest fit has grown from Controller or finance operations at a payments, wallet, fintech or high\-volume platform company, rebuilt systems hands\-on and led a small team. Big\-company titles count less than having managed the books, the funds and the transaction flows together.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in payments, fintech or other regulated businesses, working with compliance on fund controls, audit evidence and bank requirements
* SQL, BI or API data experience (real implementations matter more than tool names)
* Multi\-entity finance across Canada and the US
* Fundraising, bank credit facilities, data rooms, or investor and board communication
* Business analytics: runway, unit economics and operating KPIs

**Compensation and location**


The role offers an annual compensation package of up to CAD $300,000, including base salary and a performance\-based bonus, depending on experience.


Based in our Toronto office. Our team works in both English and Mandarin.

-----------------------------------------

**Overview**
------------


Director, Digital \& Information Management is a leadership role responsible for developing and implementing the digital strategy and information management framework for one of our major new build projects. The role is responsible for developing and implementing the digital strategy and information management framework for this project. The Director reports functionally to the Vice\-President, Digital Solutions and operationally to the Project Director.


This Director ensures that all project data, documentation, and digital systems are integrated, secure, and aligned with company standards, regulatory requirements, industry standards, and project objectives. The position drives digital transformation to enable efficient collaboration, lifecycle data management, and regulatory compliance across engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning phases.


Key responsibilities include leading project teams, developing work execution plans, recruiting and assigning team members, managing project deliverables, organizational structure, budget, schedule, risk management, and overseeing people forecasting and levelling for the project.

**Your role**
-------------

* Lead the development and execution of the Digital and Information Management strategy for a large\-scale nuclear new build project.
* Align digital initiatives with project objectives, corporate standards, regulatory requirements, and long\-term asset lifecycle management.
* Champion digital transformation through BIM, digital twins, data analytics, advanced collaboration platforms, and emerging technologies.
* Establish and govern enterprise\-wide information management frameworks, including data governance, metadata standards, and document control processes.
* Ensure compliance with nuclear industry regulations, cybersecurity standards, and industry best practices such as ISO 19650 and IEC 62645\.
* Implement and manage integrated digital systems, including BIM, EDMS, project controls, scheduling, cost management, ERP, and asset information platforms.
* Lead the deployment of Common Data Environments (CDE) and Advanced Work Packaging (AWP) solutions across EPCM partners, suppliers, and stakeholders.
* Oversee project\-wide BIM execution, ensuring cross\-disciplinary integration, interoperability, data quality, and a single source of truth for project information.
* Establish robust cybersecurity, digital safety, training, and corrective action programs to protect critical systems and ensure regulatory compliance.
* Monitor digital performance, drive stakeholder adoption, report on system effectiveness and data integrity, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement and cost optimization.

**About you**

* Strong expertise with BIM, Common Data Environments (CDE), Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS), and project controls platforms.
* Experience with integrated 3D engineering design technologies such as Hexagon SmartPlant/Smart 3D, AVEVA, or comparable plant design systems.
